correctness.rationale: Exact 27-monomial convolution identity for six complex modes after modulus majorization. The algebraic square identity (1) and Cauchy–Schwarz/AM–GM give a sharp two-mass envelope; derivative factorization has one positive critical root and strictly smaller boundary values. Equality in the nonnegative envelope forces uniformity in the three corner and three edge-midpoint groups. Three two-sum phase relations force an affine character. On grids with both sides at least five, distinct two-sums stay distinct; order four gives positive alias surplus. The standalone checker independently confirms the polynomial coefficient dictionary and selected finite/numerical cases; finite tests are not universal proofs.

value.rationale: Natural complete degree-two bivariate analytic monomial simplex has two symmetry orbits. Its exact unrestricted Fourier synthesis norm is an intrinsic operator invariant, distinct from a fixed-phase or uniform-amplitude result and strictly larger than the latter. Complete optimizer classification reveals nonflat amplitude allocation and additive phase locking, with a precise nonalias finite-sampling cutoff. The square decomposition is a structural proof method and the invariant is relevant to sharp polynomial Fourier bounds rather than an arbitrary restricted slice.
